topic: What orbital configurations justify prioritizing V-band (57-66 GHz) over optical systems for inter-satellite communication?
consensus_response: Dense satellite constellations with numerous satellites in close proximity justify prioritizing V-band due to its superior interference management and spectrum efficiency. Compact antennas and advanced beamforming techniques mitigate interference, while adaptive modulation optimizes data rates and link reliability.
reference_context: SatCom systems utilize various frequency bands, including L, S, X, Ka, and Ku, with specific uplink and downlink frequencies for user and gateway communications.
